strings.zh: 欢迎光临！{NEWLINE}这里是满金百货。
strings.en: Welcome to the Goldenrod{NEWLINE}Department Store.

strings.zh: 满金百货齐聚了各色商品。{SCROLL}但有些东西要到商场内的{NEWLINE}抽奖专柜抽奖才能得到。
strings.en: The Goldenrod Dept. Store{NEWLINE}has all kinds of goods.{SCROLL}But some things you can only{NEWLINE}get from the prize drawing at{CLEAR}the store’s lottery counter.

strings.zh: 百货店的大姐姐{NEWLINE}对我这样的小孩{CLEAR}也有好好打招呼呢,{CLEAR}专业的就是厉害。
strings.en: The ladies at this department store{NEWLINE}greet even a kid like me properly.{CLEAR}Real pros are something else.

strings.zh: 嘛,今天也要{NEWLINE}买好多东西哦！
strings.en: I’m raring to shop again today!

strings.zh: 来到满金百货,就会切身感受到{NEWLINE}满金市是座大城市,{CLEAR}这里的商品比别处可多多了。
strings.en: Coming to the Goldenrod Dept. Store{NEWLINE}really makes you feel what a big{CLEAR}city Goldenrod is. There’s way more{CLEAR}stuff here than anywhere else.

strings.zh: 我的精灵战斗时会携带特伤果,{NEWLINE}专门用来对付那些{CLEAR}擅长特殊攻击的精灵。
strings.en: My Pokémon hold a Rowap Berry in{NEWLINE}battle, specially to deal with Pokémon{CLEAR}that are good at special attacks.

strings.zh: 不能靠近{NEWLINE}穿黑衣服的人,{CLEAR}妈妈这么说过的。
strings.en: Mom told me to stay away from{NEWLINE}people in black suits.

strings.zh: 沙菲雅『满金市的商场好大呀,{NEWLINE}有好多东西我从来都没见过。

strings.zh: 路比『我跟你说我们这{NEWLINE}还有更好玩的呢。{CLEAR}一会儿我带你去这附近的草丛转一转,{CLEAR}让你见识一下我们这的精灵。
strings.en: Ruby: Let me tell you, there’s even{NEWLINE}more fun stuff around here. In a{CLEAR}bit, I’ll take you to the tall grass{CLEAR}nearby and show you our local Pokémon.

strings.zh: 沙菲雅『唉？可是……咱们又没有精灵,{NEWLINE}这么去草丛不太好吧。
strings.en: Sapphire: Huh? But... we don’t have{NEWLINE}any Pokémon. Going into the grass like{CLEAR}that doesn’t sound like a good idea.

strings.zh: 路比『怕什么,我们这的精灵{NEWLINE}都很温顺不会有危险的。{CLEAR}再说就算有什么意外,{CLEAR}我也会保护你的,放心好啦。
strings.en: Ruby: What’s there to be scared{NEWLINE}of? The Pokémon around here are{CLEAR}all gentle. They won’t hurt anyone.{CLEAR}Besides, even if something happens,{CLEAR}I’ll protect you. Don’t worry!
